He never found out, but he began leaving his own messages in bottles, each one carrying the same small promise: someone is watching the dark with you.","w02":"凌晨四点的城市还没有完全醒来。高架桥像一条发亮的河，零星的车灯缓缓流过。便利店的白光落在人行道上，清洁工推着车，早点铺升起第一缕蒸汽。写字楼里还有几扇窗亮着，像不肯睡去的眼睛。风从楼宇之间穿过，带着一点凉意。此刻的街道安静得能听见红绿灯的滴答声，仿佛整座城市都在屏住呼吸，等待天亮。","w03":"• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version.\n• It needs a base case so it knows when to stop.\n• Each call should get closer to that base case, like climbing down stairs one step at a time."}
